page_description: Interactive examples for hai-framework models, knowledge retrieval, memory, tools, agents, and media.
hero_description: Call real AI APIs and inspect chat, image generation, long-term memory, speech synthesis, and transcription results.
profile_hint: Profile labels are scoped to this browser.
memory_persistent_hint: Memories remain in the database across restarts. Delete test memories when finished.
memory_ephemeral_hint: The current in-memory database loses memory records when the service restarts.
chat_description: Multi-turn chat messages with optional memory injection and extraction.
chat_welcome: Hi, I am AI. Ask a question or tell me a preference you want me to remember.
chat_placeholder: Type a message, for example: Remember that I prefer concise answers.
memory_description: Add, search, or remove memories for the current test profile.
memory_add_placeholder: Add a fact, preference, or long-term instruction…
memory_search_placeholder: Enter a semantic query, or leave empty to list all
memory_empty: This profile has no memories yet
image_description: Generate an image through the configured OpenAI, Gemini, Qwen, Seedream, or free provider.
image_references_hint: Choose one or more images; model-specific count and format limits still apply.
image_default_prompt: A friendly robot building an open-source framework, clean isometric illustration
image_error_invalid_request: The image prompt or dimensions are invalid
image_error_invalid_reference: Upload up to four non-empty reference images totaling at most 10 MiB
tts_description: Generate a playable WAV file from text.
tts_default_text: Hello, welcome to the hai-framework AI Playground.
asr_description: Upload WAV or MP3 audio and transcribe it to text.
asr_empty_result: The model did not recognize any text.
asr_error_file_size: Audio size must be between 1 byte and 10 MiB
asr_error_file_type: Only WAV and MP3 audio are supported
asr_error_language: Language must be auto, Chinese, English, or Japanese
mic_description: See a live transcript while recording, without stopping first.
mic_placeholder: The transcript will update here while you record…
mic_error_unsupported: This browser does not support microphone recording.
mic_error_permission: Cannot access the microphone. Please check browser permissions.
mic_error_empty: No audio captured, please try again.
lab_section_setup: Configure the server and providers, then open a category to see each API, its settings, and its inputs and outputs.
lab_section_models: Try multi-turn chat, stream processing, structured output, and reasoning.
lab_section_knowledge: Parse text, generate vectors, compare ranking, and try retrieval and RAG with the sample handbook.
lab_section_context: Inspect persona prompts, context windows, token counts, summaries, and compression. Manage long-term memory separately.
lab_section_agents: Try local tools and MCP. The server can register third-party MCP, A2A, and managed ACP environments.
lab_section_media: Generate and preview images or speech, transcribe an audio file, or use live microphone transcription.
lab_setup_runtime_body: Install dependencies from the repository root with a supported Node.js and pnpm, then run pnpm --filter ai-playground dev. Microphone access requires localhost or HTTPS.
lab_setup_config_body: Select models and protocols in _ai.yml. Inject server-side credentials and endpoints using .env.example as a guide. Use the capabilities your provider actually supports.
lab_setup_storage_body: Local defaults are SQLite and LanceDB. Multi-instance deployments need shared PostgreSQL or MySQL, a network vector database, and Redis.
lab_setup_services_body: Third-party MCP needs a server-side registration and allowlist. A2A needs an Agent Card. Managed ACP also needs Runner, a container image, and a configured model.
lab_media_config: Set transcription and speech models in audio.models and image models in image.models. Reference images, voices, and languages depend on the selected model.
lab_memory_config: Set the backend with memory.provider and enable semantic search with memory.embeddingEnabled.
demo_setup_hint: Complete the server settings above, restart the app, then reload this page.
demo_request_failed: The example failed. Check the server configuration or logs.
demo_not_configured: This example is not configured on the server.
example_prompt: Explain the benefit of streamed output in two sentences.
example_document: Hai provides configuration, storage, and AI modules. The playground demonstrates models, retrieval, and tools.
example_query: Which database should I use in production?
demo_llm_description: Send one prompt and receive a model answer. Try multi-turn streamed chat below.
demo_stream_description: Split the input into chunks and observe text assembly and event counts. This example runs locally.
demo_structured_description: Ask the model for JSON validated against a schema.
demo_reasoning_description: Run a prompt through the framework reasoning flow.
demo_file_description: Parse the input as an HTML file and inspect the extracted text.
demo_embedding_description: Inspect vector dimensions and a short sample. Requires an embeddings provider.
demo_rerank_description: Rerank sample documents against a query and inspect their scores.
demo_retrieval_description: Retrieve relevant handbook excerpts with source and score.
demo_rag_description: Retrieve sample content and use it to answer the query with a model.
demo_knowledge_description: Inspect how the sample handbook is stored and searched.
demo_persona_description: Build a sample persona and inspect its system prompt.
demo_context_description: Build a temporary conversation and inspect its context.
demo_token_description: Count the tokens in the input text.
demo_summary_description: Summarize a sample conversation for later turns.
demo_compress_description: Apply compression to a temporary conversation and compare the result.
demo_tools_description: Call a fixed example tool to inspect validated input and output.
demo_mcp_description: Inspect inputs and outputs for a local MCP tool, resource, and prompt.
demo_mcp_remote_description: Call search_manual on the server-configured playground-manuals service.
demo_a2a_description: Send a message to the local A2A executor and inspect the task state.
demo_acp_description: Preview the execution plan and run an isolated read-only task with playground-acp.
demo_mcp_job_description: Extract the bundled document in an offline container. The example accepts playground-handbook.txt.
asr_stream_hint: Upload a complete file and watch incremental transcription updates.
demo_audio_capabilities_description: Inspect the configured transcription and synthesis capabilities without calling the provider. The input is ignored.
demo_tts_stream_description: Synthesize one segment and inspect its actual format, chunk count, byte count, and completion. Use the synthesis panel above for playback.
guide_setup_panel_params: config is the server-side AI configuration. options can inject a shared Store, Runner, application policy, and tool file access.
guide_setup_panel_output: Success provides a shutdown handle. Handle a failed HaiResult before serving requests.
guide_setup_panel_config: Install @h-ai/ai. Start RelDB and VecDB as configured and add Runner for containers. Read credentials from the server environment.
guide_llm_params: The first argument is the question. enablePersist: false leaves chat history unchanged.
guide_llm_output: data is an answer string on success. error carries a framework error code on failure.
guide_llm_config: Configure the model, protocol, endpoint, and private credential under llm.
guide_stream_params: No factory arguments. id, object, created, and model describe the input chunk. choices carries the candidate index, incremental delta.content, and finish_reason, which is null until finished.
guide_stream_output: getResult().content contains the accumulated text, Hello in this example.
guide_stream_config: No setup needed for local chunks. Configure llm to process an actual model stream.
guide_structured_params: schema requires a title and array of points. messages provides the input, systemPrompt guides the response, and maxRepairs limits repair retries to one. responseFormat: json_object requests generic JSON while keeping local schema validation. Omit it or use json_schema for a provider with native schema support.
guide_structured_output: data is a Zod-validated object on success. Validation or repair failure returns an error.
guide_structured_config: Configure a text model under llm and install zod for this example.
guide_reasoning_params: The first argument is the question. strategy selects the reasoning workflow, maxRounds limits rounds, and enablePersist: false skips chat history.
guide_reasoning_output: data contains answer, strategy, and rounds on success.
guide_reasoning_config: Use llm.scenarios.reasoning for a dedicated model, or the default resolver.
guide_file_params: content contains the file text. filename lets the parser identify its format by extension.
guide_file_output: data.text contains extracted text, with format metadata. Extraction does not sanitize HTML.
guide_file_config: This example parses HTML locally. Image OCR uses file and llm.scenarios.ocr.
guide_embedding_params: Pass one text string. The example reports the returned dimensions and previews the first 12 values.
guide_embedding_output: The public API returns a numeric vector in data. The workbench displays a short preview.
guide_embedding_config: Configure llm.scenarios.embedding and embedding, matching the knowledge collection dimension.
guide_rerank_params: query defines the ranking target. Each document has a stable id and text. topN limits matches and returnDocuments includes the candidates in results.
guide_rerank_output: data.results contains ranked indices and relevance scores on success.
guide_rerank_config: llm.scenarios.rerank selects a model and service supporting /v1/rerank.
guide_retrieval_params: query is the search text, sources selects registered source IDs, and topK caps the number of matches.
guide_retrieval_output: data contains retrieved passages with sources and scores.
guide_retrieval_config: Configure retrieval.sources, a vector database, and llm.scenarios.embedding.
guide_rag_params: The first argument is the question. sources selects registered sources, topK caps passages, and enablePersist: false skips chat history.
guide_rag_output: data contains answer, context, and citations on success.
guide_rag_config: Configure llm, llm.scenarios.embedding, and the vector source, then index the material.
guide_knowledge_params: collection selects the collection, documentId identifies a document, title and content provide text, enableEntityExtraction: false limits ingest to chunks and vectors, and topK caps results.
guide_knowledge_output: setup prepares the collection. ingest returns a revision. retrieve returns passages from published documents.
guide_knowledge_config: Configure knowledge and llm.scenarios.embedding, with relational and vector databases running.
guide_persona_params: id identifies a temporary persona. objectId comes from authenticated identity. name is the display name. systemPrompt and traits define its behavior.
guide_persona_output: After save, compose returns the combined prompt. finally removes the example persona.
guide_persona_config: Use an initialized AI Store and keep operations under the same authorized identity.
guide_context_params: scope binds the subject and session IDs. systemPrompt defines the initial system message. compress.maxTokens sets the budget.
guide_context_output: Read the usage budget and messages from the successful manager handle.
guide_context_config: Set optional compression and estimation defaults under compress and token.
guide_token_params: content is the text to estimate. Message estimation additionally takes a role.
guide_token_output: Both return numeric estimates. The message estimate includes protocol overhead.
guide_token_config: token.tokenRatio controls local estimation. Billing uses provider usage.
guide_summary_params: Pass the ordered ChatMessage array. role identifies the speaker, and content contains the message.
guide_summary_output: data contains the summary, token estimate, and covered message count.
guide_summary_config: Use summary.systemPrompt and llm.scenarios.summary to configure summarization.
guide_compress_params: The messages provide role and content in order. strategy selects the algorithm, maxTokens is the budget, and preserveLastN keeps the latest message.
guide_compress_output: data contains compressed messages and the before-and-after token estimates.
guide_compress_config: Set defaults under compress. This example selects the local sliding window explicitly.
guide_tools_params: name and description identify the tool, parameters validates the input, and handler receives validated text. A call includes id, type, function.name, and JSON arguments.
guide_tools_output: Success returns a tool message whose content is words: 2.
guide_tools_config: No model needed. A real application can add authorization to the tool registry.
guide_mcp_params: The tool name and text invoke a registered handler. The resource URI selects a resource. The prompt name and topic select and fill the template.
guide_mcp_output: The three HaiResults contain the tool object, resource content, and prompt messages.
guide_mcp_config: Register the tool, resource, and prompt after initializing AI. The in-process demo needs no remote MCP service.
guide_mcp_remote_params: serviceId selects a deployment entry, tool selects an allowed operation, and arguments.query holds the text. access carries the trusted principal and argument-aware authorization.
guide_mcp_remote_output: data.content holds upstream MCP content. Denials and upstream failures return a HaiResult error.
guide_mcp_remote_config: Set transport: http, the endpoint, credential references, and allowedTools in mcp.servers.
guide_mcp_job_params: serviceId and tool select the managed document operation. arguments.fileId names an authorized object. The host builds access from trusted identity.
guide_mcp_job_output: data.structuredContent.text contains the sample document text.
guide_mcp_job_config: Register transport: job, the offline Runner environment, and authorized file access.
guide_a2a_params: jsonrpc is the protocol version, id correlates the request, and method selects SendMessage. message.role, messageId, and parts carry the speaker and text. agentId comes from the trusted caller.
guide_a2a_output: getAgentCard returns discovery metadata. handleRequest returns the JSON-RPC result of this local echo.
guide_a2a_config: Configure a2a.agentCard and register an executor. This example runs in-process.
guide_acp_params: tenantId and userId come from authentication. agentId selects the agent. mode uses a dedicated task, profile is read-only, approval never prompts, and prompt describes the task.
guide_acp_output: plan reports the effective environment and resources. run returns taskId, output, and effective options on success.
guide_acp_config: Register acp.agents and a model, then inject Runner. The executor supplies the cached pinned image and model gateway.
guide_audio_capabilities_params: operation selects transcription or synthesis. Omitting model uses the default for that operation.
guide_audio_capabilities_output: Returns a synchronous HaiResult with capability metadata. No provider request is made.
guide_audio_capabilities_config: Register both operation models and their default IDs under audio.
guide_tts_stream_params: text.id identifies the segment, text.text is what to speak, and format requests WAV.
guide_tts_stream_output: The stream yields segment start, audio, and segment completion events. The example totals data.byteLength.
guide_tts_stream_config: audio.synthesizeModel selects the default model. Streaming depends on its capabilities.
guide_chat_panel_params: objectId comes from authenticated identity, sessionId identifies the session, and messages contains the chat history. scope.topicId limits memory. topK, maxTokens, and position control injection. enablePersist and max_tokens control persistence and generation.
guide_chat_panel_output: The async iterator yields model chunks for incremental text. Stream failures throw.
guide_chat_panel_config: llm selects the model. memory configures memory storage and search.
guide_memory_panel_params: objectId and scope.topicId delimit storage. content, type, and importance define the entry. A search string and topK limit recall. remove accepts the entry ID.
guide_memory_panel_output: add returns the saved entry, recall returns matches, and successful remove returns undefined in data.
guide_memory_panel_config: Configure memory storage and a compatible embedding model if vector search is enabled.
guide_image_panel_params: prompt describes the image. size.width and height are pixel dimensions. Optional referenceImages carries image bytes with MIME types.
guide_image_panel_output: data.images contains generated bytes and MIME types.
guide_image_panel_config: Use image.models and image.generateModel. Reference images require provider support.
guide_tts_panel_params: text is what to read, voice is the provider voice, instruction controls style, and format requests WAV.
guide_tts_panel_output: data includes audio bytes, format, and metadata for playback or storage.
guide_tts_panel_config: audio.synthesizeModel selects the default. Voice and style support depend on the provider.
guide_asr_panel_params: audio.data and format describe the uploaded bytes. language hints at the target language. signal cancels the stream.
guide_asr_panel_output: transcribe returns data.text. transcribeStream yields transcript and done events. Replace the text with the current full transcript on each update.
guide_mic_panel_params: snapshot is a complete WAV snapshot of the current recording, and audio.format is wav.
guide_mic_panel_output: Success returns the transcript for that snapshot. The page updates about every two seconds.
guide_mic_panel_config: Requires a secure context, microphone permission, and audio.transcribeModel. Snapshots use ordinary transcription.
